pr.title: fix(freehire-search): reject detail URLs on other hosts instead of asking the API for their last segment (#622)
pr.body:
Fixes #622. The freehire sibling of #500 (linkedin) and #448 (jobindex).

## What was wrong

`normalizeSlug` ([master, helpers.ts:232-240](https://github.com/MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search/blob/5d9e097/.agents/skills/freehire-search/cli/src/helpers.ts#L232-L240)) matched `/jobs/<x>` against the raw string with no host check. A freehire search result's own `url` field is the employer's apply link (the repo's `commands.test.ts` fixture uses `https://boards.greenhouse.io/acme/jobs/1`); pasting it back into `detail` reduced it to `1` and the handler requested `/api/v1/jobs/1`, then reported `NOT_FOUND` for a URL that was never a freehire posting. Real handler with `fetch` stubbed (script in #622):

| input | master | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| `https://boards.greenhouse.io/acme/jobs/1` | requests `/api/v1/jobs/1`, `NOT_FOUND` | no request, exit 1 `BAD_ID` |
| `https://freehire.me.evil.io/jobs/x` | requests `/api/v1/jobs/x` | no request, `BAD_ID` |
| `https://freehire.me/jobs/golang-zensar-2bxu6dxm` | correct | unchanged |

Every other portal CLI rejects an off-host detail URL with `BAD_ID`; freehire was the last one trusting the path.

## What changes

- **`helpers.ts`**: URLs are parsed with `new URL()`. `freehire.me` (apex or any subdomain, scheme optional) **or the host of `FREEHIRE_API_URL`** (so a self-hosted instance keeps working) plus a `/jobs/<slug>` path yields the slug; other hosts, look-alike hosts (`freehire.me.evil.io`, `notfreehire.me`), userinfo tricks (`freehire.me@evil.io`) and non-job freehire pages (`/companies/acme`, `/jobs/`) return `null`, so the existing `BAD_ID` branch exits 1 before any request. Bare slugs are unchanged; trailing slash and query string are accepted. All three existing `normalizeSlug` cases still pass.
- **Tests**: five new `normalizeSlug` cases in `parsing.test.ts` (including the self-host case with `FREEHIRE_API_URL` set and restored), and a handler-level case in `commands.test.ts` that pastes the fixture's own apply URL into `runDetail` with fetch stubbed and asserts `BAD_ID` with zero requests. Against master's `src/`, four cases fail.
- **`SKILL.md`**: the detail section says an off-host URL is rejected with `BAD_ID`.
- CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` / Fixed entry.

## Verification

`bun run typecheck` clean; `bun test` 63 pass / 0 fail with fetch stubbed. Repo checks green. No test touches the network.
